state.task: Re-judge the HUD code source after a licensing fact was added. Observations only; the user decides.
state.user_instruction: Make the UI/UX and HUD like production games (PUBG, battle royales, My Summer Car), taking or adapting OSS or snippet source code, or referencing them.
state.chosen_layout: PUBG-style edge elements (compass bar with task marker, radio feed, held equipment) plus My-Summer-Car-style centre naming and action prompt, hold-progress ring, TAB work-order/equipment screen, M station map, Esc pause menu, title screen.

facts.repository: The project repository xrlab-dau/CHOOGuard is public on GitHub.
facts.fps_microgame: Unity's FPS Microgame ships uGUI HUD scripts (Compass, CompassMarker, NotificationToast, ObjectiveHUDManager, InGameMenuManager, LoadSceneButton). Its Third-PartyNotice states the asset is governed by the Unity Asset Store EULA, which licenses use inside a product but not redistribution of the asset in source form; committing its scripts to a public repository is a redistribution risk.
facts.ui_extensions: Unity UI Extensions: BSD-3-Clause package (some files carry MIT headers); RadialLayout is only a layout component.
facts.interaction_toolkit: Unity-FirstPersonInteractionToolkit: MPL-2.0 (file-level copyleft), legacy Text and legacy Input APIs.
facts.project: uGUI + TextMeshPro Korean SDF font, Input System; an existing small FpsUiFactory for canvases, labels and panels.

hud_code_source.instructions: Where should the HUD implementation come from given the public repository?

criteria.own_code_referencing_microgame: Write the project's own uGUI/TMP HUD components, using FPS Microgame and PUBG/MSC only as structural and visual references; copy only permissively licensed snippets (MIT/BSD) with notices kept.
criteria.copy_microgame_scripts: Copy FPS Microgame scripts into the repository and modify them.
criteria.mpl_toolkit_port: Port the MPL-2.0 toolkit files and keep them under MPL.
